Version 1.0.1 — No file/content changes detected.

- No changes were made in this version.
- Functionality, documentation, and specifications remain the same as the previous release.

Thesis-Topic-Selector v1.0.0

- Initial release: generate innovative, academically-rigorous thesis topics in any field using four AI-powered innovation modes (direct use, improvement, migration, construction).
- Introduces 10 built-in innovation frameworks (e.g., first principles, reverse thinking, dialectics, emergence, gamification) to guide topic generation.
- Each generated topic is evaluated with a strict 4-dimension standard: clarity, theoretical foundation, scope, and originality.
- Supports mode self-selection and cross-mode analysis, helping users discover, combine, and deepen unique research directions.
- Adaptive for all academic disciplines, from social sciences and humanities to STEM fields.
